name: Zhejiang Goldensea Hi-Tech Co., Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Goldensea Hi-Tech Co., Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sale of filter materials in China and internationally. The company offers various filter materials, such as automotive filter materials, multi-functional and compound air filter materials, melt-blown air filter materials, melt-blown filter material for masks, and PAF filter materials; air filter, including PM25 air filter, multifunction air filter, cabin filter, aviation cabin filter, and heat recovery ventilation; and general and functional filter mesh.
